label: Absolute_gyrification_index (ratio)
definition: Absolute gyrification index (AbsGI) as defined by Heuer et al. A sphere has the minimum value, 1; the authors report about 4 for a human cerebrum. Dimensionless; species mean of the paper's specimens. The archived values are whole-cerebrum values: for the 28 species with one specimen, AbsGI equals Cerebral_surface_area divided by the surface area of a sphere of Cerebral_volume (both hemispheres together), although the paper words the definition for a cerebral hemisphere. NOT the Zilles 2-D coronal-contour GI and never pooled with it, nor with the Mota & Herculano-Houzel folding index (owner decision 2026-07-31).

definition: Home range in km2: the area an animal or social group habitually traverses in its normal activities. POOLED variable, assembled by precedence from four secondary compilations and never averaged across them, because the compilations partly re-report the same primary studies and define home range differently (where they overlap, their values differ by a median of about 2x): PanTHERIA (Jones et al. 2009) supplies the value where it has the species; Galán-Acedo et al. 2019 fills the next gaps; then Kamilar & Cooper 2013; then Chivers 1984, converted from ha (x 0.01). Each pooled value is therefore one compilation's value; the contributing compilations are named per row in Teams/items and the across-compilation spread is kept in value_min/value_max. Source-specific views remain as Home_range_Galan2019 (km2), Home_range_Kamilar2013 (km2) and Home_range_Chivers1984 (ha). Not Max_home_range_ha, which is a maximum.
